responsibility: This is the main tree-to-RTL expression expander for GCC’s middle-to-back-end boundary. It initializes mode-specific load/store capabilities, expands expressions, assignments, conversions, block moves, constants, vector constructors, switch table jumps, EH personality references, and object-size computations into RTL, coordinating helpers from optabs, calls, dojump, expmed, and explow to produce executable RTL for individual expressions and data movements.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the main tree-to-RTL expander in the `expr` group: it drives expression, move, block, switch, and object-size lowering, whereas `gcc/expr.h` exposes the public expansion enums and entry points.
